## Result

Installs the D3 art direction into the live Godot world: native-size sprites and integer zoom, shared foot-based sorting, layered terrain, deterministic palette variants, activity frames/effects, and a Korean Galmuri interface. This is a **partial visual delivery**, not production art acceptance.

Stacked on #510. Target: `codex/revitalize-2026-10`; source: `codex/art-production-2026-10`. No simulation/bridge/probe changes are included. Rust edits only repin renderer-source assertions, with a ledger and mutation evidence.

## Evidence and limits

- 42 generation calls: 13 unique accepted cells + 243 explicitly procedural fallbacks. All 256 production slots are installed; 272 atlas frames include the 16 retained D3 cells.
- 92 actual windowed captures. A1–A4, A6–A10 and A12 pass; exact pixel-grid/y-sort/palette-ramp framebuffer checks pass.
- **A5 fails:** minimum contrast 0.0548 vs 0.10, with 8 occluded/unmeasurable villagers. **A11 fails:** 4/24 (16.67%) activity recognition at both zooms. Two independent visual reviews recommend REVISE.
- Converter section6.1 remains unmet: raw JPEG color recovery35.71–60%, and a strong4px/8px harmonic counterexample. The separate literal audit intentionally exits1; ordinary regression success does not erase this failure.
- Static assertion audit:474/474 mapped mutants killed across two pinned targets;343 ledger rows,338 mutant-linked +5 diagnostic-only reasons.291 unrelated inventory candidates were not run.
- Clean local compatibility merge with simulation `a8611e07aabbb4043f5fac2e8dd14b375a0ada5d`:16 evening sitters near the hearth,23 night sleepers hidden on shelter tiles, child frames consumed. Noon child is visually occluded. Temporary branch was deleted and never pushed.

Full Korean report: [`docs/art/production/REPORT.md`](https://github.com/hyunlord/new-world/blob/codex/art-production-2026-10/docs/art/production/REPORT.md).

Rust1,806 tests, Clippy with warnings denied, strict GDScript, bridge build,900-frame headless smoke without script errors, Python57 tests, and12 Godot art scene tests pass. WIP and green were verified against `git ls-remote` at this same SHA. Green denotes code-gate success, not visual acceptance.

Committed checkpoint logs: `docs/art/production/gates/final/`. Exact-head repeat logs remain in `.harness/evidence/art-production/final-head-gate/` so verification does not mutate the tested commit. ## Art Pass 2 — bounded recovery, technical green, visual gaps retained

Published HEAD `b2f0ce15d069aee6dd3e09cb1248a2608cbb7600`. The exact publication commit passed the full **25/25** gate: Rust **1,850 passed / 0 failed**, Clippy all targets, strict GDScript, bridge build, 900-frame smoke without script errors, Python **129**, and **18** Godot art tests. WIP and green were each verified with `git ls-remote` at this SHA. The PR remains draft; green means the code gate passed, not visual acceptance.

Recovered **141 original sprites + 3 derived + 16 newly generated**, with **75 procedural + 31 fallback** drawables and **27 suppressed** targets. New image calls stopped at **6/18** because only **15/96** previously missing targets passed the checkpoint. Adult/child native scale remains **28/21**.

Actual windowed QA: 94 game captures + 4 calibration captures; forest **326/1,190 = 27.395%**, zero clearing violations; 300 live frames median **6.111 ms**, p95 **15.230 ms**. **A1, A5 and A11 still FAIL**: calibration colors61<64; contrast median0.1058/min0.0011; blind recognition **16/24 at4×, 13/24 at2×**. A13 silhouette PASS can reflect direction-only idle differences and does not establish readable activity poses. Carry remains idle+icon fallback in26frames.

Latest simulation green `7a8ae053059f3d3eed376a427eadec235259fecd` merged cleanly on a local temporary branch: bridge +22headless checks passed and10windowed captures completed. The branch was deleted without pushing. The actual one-based season-day contract was corrected in art; spring day2 was observed. Elder/old-age death and full seasonal rollover were not naturally observed.

## Art Pass 3 — quieter camp, real age and seasons, visual limits retained

Publication HEAD `ece4e85e5e0b48945dddef61ba601a144db1397a`. The exact publication commit passes **28/28** full-gate checks: Rust **1,881 tests**, Clippy all targets, strict **26 GDScript files / 15 FFI calls**, bridge, 900-frame error-free smoke, Python **177**, and **21 Godot art tests**. WIP and green are verified at the same SHA; this PR stays **draft**. Technical green is not visual acceptance.

- Clearings now exclude all natural objects, rocks cluster at **6.045% hills /45.283% mountains**, and ground decals occupy **3.240% grass /2.437% forest**. All 13 installed decals fit8px; leaves6px.
- Hair depends solely on life stage; idle turns south after1s and camp resting poses remain render-only. Real Pass4 data drives inspector age, season HUD/tint, and old-age news/death counts. Natural first old-age death was observed on day22; day40 shows nine visible elders and death tally14.
- Re-reviewed **366 physical candidates /33 sheets**, recovering **7 original cells and0 old-fill cells**. New generation stopped at the required checkpoint: **4/12 calls,64 candidates,0 approvals**. Final269 drawables:167 accepted,3 derived,68 procedural,31 fallback. Carry still has18 idle icons; adult_b uses2 real carry frames plus8 borrowed views. All169 installed region maps retain exact reviewed maps; v2 full rollout remains incomplete.
- Actual captures: **94 art +7 long +4 separate calibration**. Capture-only visibility was corrected so retired/sheltered sprites are not resurrected, then all captures repeated. **A5, A7, A11, A16 remain FAIL**: contrast day2 median.0948/min.0029 and winter.1093/.0031; two distinct carry frames per second instead of3; blind4x18/24 and2x14/24; requested day40 spring contradicts the actual seven-day season cycle (summer5). A separate day32 spring strip is supplied.
- 300 live frames: median **6.048ms**, p95 **15.162ms** versus Art2 **6.111/15.230ms**. Exact ramp/grid/sort checks pass. Winter ramp measurement excludes five fully occluded villagers. Physical mouse clicks were not automated; the real inspector display path and contract tests were exercised.
- Pinned Pass4 merge was clean. Advanced simulation `2f04737989301b9b753f14053b19e39207411eb2` also merged cleanly in temporary detached commit `29988ca07f1571bd3be938abace5a63abdc02854`:25 compatibility checks and10 actual windowed captures passed. That game_v11 day1/2/6 check is bounded, was not pushed, and is not a full long-run visual revalidation.

Fixed missing woodpiles and stale stock/resource presentation during capture review.

No breakfast or manual windowed click claim.
